This charming Set of three Laura Ashley Crackled Glass Lit Ornaments casts a warm, inviting glow that transforms any mantel or tabletop into a cosy winter retreat. When illuminated, each ornament reveals an intricate forest scene straight from a snow-dusted fairy tale.

Featuring a chic, minimalist silver finish, these pre-lit ornaments exude sleek sophistication with their rustic beauty. From their exquisite crackled texture to their captivating woodland imagery, this Laura Ashley trio is the perfect addition to your holiday decor.
